 Adem Bona 
 PHI 
 Forward 
 #30 
 Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown, Dean Wade and Adem Bona will start Saturday’s game against the Hornets. 
 Brown is back after sitting out Friday’s win over the Knicks, but the 76ers are giving LeBron James and Joel Embiid the night off. As a result, Wade remains a starter, and Bona starts at center. 
 Jabari Walker 
 PHI 
 Forward 
 #33 
 Jabari Walker (knee) and Tacko Fall (quad) are available for Saturday’s game against the Hornets. 
 While Walker has missed Philadelphia’s last three games, Fall was injured during the preseason and has not seen any action. With LeBron James and Joel Embiid out, the 76ers may have opportunities for Walker or Fall to provide frontcourt depth. 
 Jabari Walker 
 PHI 
 Forward 
 #33 
 Jabari Walker (knee) is questionable for Saturday’s game against the Hornets. 
 Walker has missed the last three games with a knee injury. If he’s out again, Adem Bona should start and see plenty of minutes with Joel Embiid (foot) also out. 
 Jabari Walker 
 PHI 
 Forward 
 #33 
 Jabari Walker (knee) is out for Wednesday’s game against the Pacers. 
 Walker will miss a second consecutive game after leaving Saturday’s win over the Bucks in the third quarter. While his absence may give Adem Bona a few more minutes, Joel Embiid will be available after sitting out Sunday’s loss to the Pistons. 
 Jabari Walker 
 PHI 
 Forward 
 #33 
 Jabari Walker (knee) is out for Sunday’s game against the Pistons. 
 Walker limped off the court during the third quarter of Saturday’s win over the Bucks and did not return. According to the 76ers’ injury report, he’s dealing with a sore left knee. With Joel Embiid (foot) also ruled out for Sunday, Adem Bona’s playing time is likely to increase, but he isn’t worth the streaming risk in most leagues. 
 Joel Embiid 
 PHI 
 Center-Forward 
 #21 
 Joel Embiid said after Thursday’s win over the Cavaliers that he will miss one of the 76ers’ final two games of the week. 
 The 76ers were the only team with a four-game Week 1, which will conclude with a Saturday-Sunday back-to-back. Embiid sitting out one game of a back-to-back, especially this early in the season, is not a surprise. The only issue is that he didn’t reveal which game he’ll miss, with the 76ers hosting Milwaukee on Saturday and Detroit on Sunday. Given the strength of those teams, the Bucks may be the team that misses out on having to deal with “The Process.” Adem Bona or Jabari Walker could get a spot start, and LeBron James may spend a little more time at center as a small-ball alternative. 
 Dominick Barlow 
 PHI 
 Forward 
 #25 
 Dominick Barlow (back) and Tacko Fall (quad) are out for Thursday’s game against the Cavaliers. 
 Neither Barlow nor Fall played in Tuesday’s win over the Knicks, and both may be looking at extended absences. Barlow’s injury is more impactful, as he will play rotation minutes once healthy. Adem Bona served as the backup center on Tuesday, but he played only 10 minutes, which isn’t enough to affect fantasy basketball. 
 Dean Wade 
 PHI 
 Forward-Center 
 #45 
 Dean Wade (ankle) is questionable for Thursday’s game against the Cavaliers. 
 Wade went through an individual workout ahead of Tuesday’s win over the Knicks but was deemed unfit to play. If he can play against his former team on Thursday, that would likely drop Jabari Walker out of the rotation entirely, with Kentavious Caldwell-Pope likely playing less after logging 26 minutes in the opener. 
 Adem Bona 
 PHI 
 Forward 
 #30 
 Adem Bona (foot) is available to play against the Knicks on Tuesday. 
 Bona was initially listed as questionable for this game, but he has been cleared to suit up for the season opener. He will fill out the backup center minutes behind Joel Embiid, which may end up being a significant reserve role.
